objective:
Create the domain contracts, name rules and shared test support that the rest of work item DS1 (domain services) builds on. Pure Kotlin/JVM only.

CONTEXT: Multi-module Android project. core-domain (pure Kotlin/JVM, plugin kotlin.jvm, only testImplementation(kotlin("test"))) has package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.model with persisted enums: ActivityState(COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS), ActivityResolution(EXISTING_ACTIVITY, NEW_ACTIVITY, AMBIGUOUS, UNRESOLVED), ProcessingState(CAPTURED, QUEUED_FOR_PHONE, TRANSCRIBED, INTERPRETING, INTERPRETED, PERSISTED, NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, FAILED_FINAL), TimePrecision(EXACT, APPROXIMATE, DATE_ONLY, INFERRED_NOW), VisibilityStatus(ACTIVE, HIDDEN), CanonicalActivityStatus(ACTIVE, MERGED, ARCHIVED), CorrectionSource(USER, REINTERPRETATION), CaptureSource(PHONE_VOICE, PHONE_TEXT, WATCH_VOICE), InterpretationOperation(LOG_ACTIVITY, QUERY_HISTORY, UNSUPPORTED), ValidationStatus(VALID, INVALID, NEEDS_REVIEW), ConfidenceBand(HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), plus VocabularyNamesTest pinning their names. Do NOT change those enums. core-testing (pure Kotlin/JVM, api(kotlin("test"))) contains only a placeholder ScaffoldFixtures.kt. core-data (Android library, Room) implements persistence and is NOT in scope; its interpretations table has: raw_capture_id, created_at, interpreter_version TEXT, prompt_version TEXT, schema_version INT, operation, activity_resolution, matched_activity_id?, proposed_canonical_name?, activity_state?, temporal_expression?, resolved_occurred_at?, time_precision?, model_confidence_band?, candidate_context_hash?, structured_result_json?, validation_status, validation_reason?. Raw captures: id, source, source_surface?, captured_at, captured_zone_id (IANA), raw_text, speech_confidence?, speech_alternatives_json?, processing_state. Occurrences: id, canonical_activity_id, raw_capture_id (unique), effective_interpretation_id, captured_at, occurred_at, time_precision, activity_state, visibility_status. Canonical activities: id, display_name, normalized_name, status.

BUILD (public API under com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain; sub-packages your call, e.g. .interpretation, .repository, .naming; exact type names your call but keep these semantics and KDoc them):
1. Domain types: InterpretationCandidate(operation: InterpretationOperation, activityResolution: ActivityResolution, matchedActivityId: String?, proposedCanonicalName: String?, activityState: ActivityState?, temporalExpression: String?, confidenceBand: ConfidenceBand?). CandidateActivity(id, displayName, aliases: List<String>). InterpretationInput(rawText, capturedAt: Instant, zoneId: ZoneId, candidates: List<CandidateActivity>). CatalogActivity(id, displayName, normalizedName, normalizedAliases: List<String>, lastOccurredAt: Instant?) - ACTIVE activities only by contract. StoredCapture(id, rawText, source: CaptureSource, capturedAt: Instant, zoneId: ZoneId, speechConfidence: Double?, processingState: ProcessingState, hasOccurrence: Boolean). OccurrenceView(id, canonicalActivityId, rawCaptureId, effectiveInterpretationId, capturedAt: Instant, occurredAt: Instant, timePrecision, activityState, visibilityStatus). ActivityView(id, displayName, normalizedName, status: CanonicalActivityStatus). InterpreterProvenance(interpreterVersion: String, promptVersion: String, schemaVersion: Int). InterpretationRecord mirroring the interpretations columns except id and raw capture id, with Instant for createdAt/resolvedOccurredAt. NewRawCapture(source, sourceSurface?, capturedAt: Instant, zoneId: ZoneId, rawText, speechConfidence?, speechAlternativesJson?, processingState). Do not validate AI semantics here (later task).
2. ActivityInterpreter interface: val provenance: InterpreterProvenance; suspend fun interpret(input: InterpretationInput): InterpretationResult, where InterpretationResult is sealed: Success(candidate, structuredResultJson: String?) | Failure(kind: InterpreterFailureKind {UNAVAILABLE, RETRYABLE, MALFORMED, OTHER}, structuredResultJson: String?). Failure carries no user text other than the optional structured JSON the model returned.
3. ActivityRepository interface (full contract; a later task implements it in core-data, another consumes it). All suspend:
   - createRawCapture(capture: NewRawCapture): String (id)
   - getCapture(id): StoredCapture?
   - loadCatalog(): List<CatalogActivity>
   - recordOutcome(captureId, interpretation: InterpretationRecord?, processingState: ProcessingState) - atomic; for NEEDS_REVIEW / INVALID / FAILED_RETRYABLE outcomes; never creates an occurrence
   - acceptInterpretation(captureId, interpretation: InterpretationRecord, target: ActivityTarget, occurredAt: Instant, timePrecision, activityState): String (occurrence id; idempotent per capture - returns the existing occurrence id and writes nothing if one exists)
   - applyCorrection(occurrenceId, changes: CorrectionChanges, source: CorrectionSource, reason: String?, now: Instant): CorrectionOutcome
   - getOccurrence(id): OccurrenceView?
   - getActivity(id): ActivityView?
   ActivityTarget sealed: Existing(activityId) | New(displayName). CorrectionChanges(activity: ActivityTarget? = null, occurredAt: Instant? = null, timePrecision: TimePrecision? = null, activityState: ActivityState? = null). CorrectionOutcome sealed: Applied(correctionId) | NothingChanged. The repository normalizes names itself (callers pass display names).
4. NameNormalizer: normalize(text): trim; collapse any whitespace run to one space; lowercase with Locale.ROOT; strip leading/trailing punctuation (Unicode punctuation categories, repeatedly, re-trimming exposed whitespace); internal punctuation preserved. Idempotent.
5. NewActivityNameCheck: check(name): Ok | Invalid(reason enum). Rules: length 1-60 after trimming (empty/too long); normalized form non-empty; not digits-only; no date/time words as whole words (today, yesterday, tomorrow, tonight, morning, afternoon, evening, ago, full English weekday and month names); no first-person narrative opener ("i ", "i've ", "i'm ", "we ", "we've ", case-insensitive); no completion-status words (completed, finished, done) as whole words; no filler words (stuff, things, thing) as whole words. Reason enum names your call. Must satisfy: "I flushed the water heater today", "Water heater stuff", "Completed dryer cleaning activity" all Invalid; "Flush water heater", "Clean dryer vent", "Replace smoke detector battery", "Mow lawn", "Edge lawn", "Change oil" all Ok.
6. core-testing: add a dependency on project(":core-domain") in core-testing/build.gradle.kts; delete ScaffoldFixtures.kt; add MutableClock (java.time.Clock subclass with settable/advanceable instant and a zone), FakeActivityInterpreter (settable provenance; scripted results in order or a lambda; records received inputs; call count), and runSuspend(block: suspend () -> T): T implemented with kotlin.coroutines.startCoroutine and a result-capturing Continuation, throwing IllegalStateException if the block suspends without completing (no coroutines library). Add testImplementation(project(":core-testing")) to core-domain/build.gradle.kts and prove it builds and runs. If Gradle rejects that dependency direction, put these helpers in core-domain/src/test instead and report exactly what failed.
7. Tests using whatever test runner setup already works for core-domain (see VocabularyNamesTest): NameNormalizer, NewActivityNameCheck, runSuspend, MutableClock, FakeActivityInterpreter. Helper tests may live in core-testing/src/test or core-domain/src/test.

No logging. No Android, Room, ML Kit or kotlinx-coroutines in core-domain or core-testing. No Instant.now()/System.currentTimeMillis()/ZoneId.systemDefault() in core-domain main.
non_goals: No temporal resolver, candidate selector, validator, orchestrator, correction service or review resolution logic (later tasks).
No changes to core-data, core-ai, core-speech, core-wear-protocol, app-phone, app-wear.
No changes to the existing persisted enums in core-domain .../core/domain/model or to VocabularyNamesTest.
No new entries in gradle/libs.versions.toml; if something genuinely fails without one, report status scope_change_requested instead of adding it.
No docs, tracking files or .sdlc changes.
Do not disable, @Ignore or weaken any test. Do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: All types and both interfaces (ActivityInterpreter, ActivityRepository) from objective items 1-3 exist in core-domain main as public API, with KDoc stating each repository function's contract (atomicity of recordOutcome, idempotency of acceptInterpretation, NothingChanged semantics, repository normalizes names).
core-domain/build.gradle.kts plugins and main dependencies unchanged; the only added dependency is testImplementation(project(":core-testing")) (or none, with the failure reported).

NameNormalizer tests: whitespace collapse (tabs/newlines/multiple spaces); case folding; '  Mow lawn!! ' -> 'mow lawn'; '"Edge lawn."' -> 'edge lawn'; 're-caulk tub' unchanged; empty and punctuation-only input -> ''; idempotency over a list of inputs.

NewActivityNameCheck tests: the three Bad examples are Invalid with their specific reason asserted; the six Good examples are Ok; lengths 1 and 60 Ok, blank and 61 Invalid; digits-only Invalid; names containing 'Saturday' or 'September' Invalid; 'Morning walk' Invalid by design, documented in KDoc as a conservative trade-off.

runSuspend tests: returns the value; rethrows the block's exception; throws IllegalStateException for a block that suspends and never resumes. MutableClock test: instant(), getZone(), withZone, advance. FakeActivityInterpreter test: scripted results in order, recorded inputs.
ScaffoldFixtures is deleted and nothing references it (grep).
grep over core-domain/src/main and core-testing/src/main finds no android., androidx., com.google.mlkit, kotlinx.coroutines, Instant.now(, System.currentTimeMillis, ZoneId.systemDefault, println.
`./gradlew :core-domain:test :core-testing:test --rerun-tasks` and `./gradlew test` both pass; report per-class JUnit XML test counts for the new test classes.
